{# Where a sidebar entry for a section should link to. A section that exists only as a container — an _index.md with no body, whose content lives in a child page — can point its nav entry at that page with `extra.nav_url` in its frontmatter: [extra] nav_url = "@/server/service/sync/synchronisation/index.md" The @/…md form is resolved at build time, so a rename or typo fails the build rather than silently 404ing. Sections without nav_url link to themselves. This lives in its own file because Tera macros can only call macros from a file they import, and a macro file importing itself recurses forever. #} {% macro nav_href(s) %}{%- if s.extra.nav_url -%}{{ get_url(path=s.extra.nav_url) | safe }}{%- else -%}{{ s.permalink | safe }}{%- endif -%}{% endmacro nav_href %}
